conclusion: RPP .8 command-space acceleration cannot overcome .08 input deadband; 1.5 starts with accurate angular odometry but fails the 18-second progress budget with zero angular twist; 3.2 passes all three sensor/actuator conditions while simulated actual acceleration remains <=.8 and speed <=.4.
limitations: Physical slew limits are imposed by this simulator; this is not verification of the real chassis slew response. Geometry is an open known map; corner-following remains separately required.
